definitions.short: to trample ; hence, to wash (properly, by stamping with the feet), whether literal (including the fulling process) or figurative
definitions.full: H3526. kabas [ כָּבַס ] 51 verb (tread), wash (Late Hebrew id. ; Phoenician כבס as participle; Assyrian kabâsu , tread ( down ), subjugate , kibšu , step, path , Dl HWB ) — Qal Participle only כוֺבֵס שְׂדֵה מְסִלַּת highway of fuller's (= treader's, washer's ) field Isa 7:3 ; 36:2 = 2Kin 18:17 . Pi`el Perfect וְכִּבֶּס consecutive Lev 13:6 11 t.; כִּבֵּס Gen 49:11 ; 2Sam 19:25 , etc.; Imperfect יְכַבֵּס Lev 11:25 16 t.; 2 masculine singular suffix תְּכַבְּסֵנִי Psa 51:9 , etc.; Imperative suffix כַּבְּסֵנִי 51:4 ; feminine singular כַּבְּסִי Jer 4:14 ; Participle plural מְכַבְּסִים Mal 3:2 ; — 1 wash garments (i.e. by treading ) Exod 19:10 , 14 (E), 2Sam 19:25 ; figurative of Judah Gen 49:11 ; elsewhere chiefly P: Lev 6:20 ; 11:25 , 28 ; 13:6 , 34 ; 15:11 ; Num 8:9 +; || רָחץ (which = wash person ) Lev 14:8-9 , 15:5-6 , 7 , 8 , 10 , 11 + ( ׳כ in Leviticus 27 t., || ׳ר 15t.; in Numbers 8 t., || ׳ר 3t.); Participle = fuller (compare Qal), only מְכ ׳בֹּרִית Mal 3:2 . 2 wash person, only in poetry and figurative בַּנֶּתֶר תְּכַבְּסִי אִם Jer 2:22 ; לִבֵךְ מֵרָעָה כַּבְּסִי 4:14 ; with suffix Psa 51:4 (|| טהר ; + מֵעָוֺן ); 51:9 (|| חִטֵּא ). Pu`al Perfect וְכֻבַּס consecutive Lev 13:58 ; 15:17 be washed , of garment. Hothpa`al (Ges § 54 , 3) Infinitive אֶתהַֿנֶּגַע הֻכַּבֵּס אַחֲרֵי Lev 13:55 after the plague is washed out , so 13:56 .
